messages:
Eve (Product): Quick sync — need to lock scope for the prio-canvas initiative to meet a customer pilot (LumenHealth). Core asks: runtime prefix/KV cache, dedicated reserved capacity, security HSM review, and a clear fallback routing policy. Can we align owners + deadlines?

Priyanka (Eng): What are the acceptance perf targets?

Eve (Product): 95p latency < 120ms for ~512-token requests, sustained throughput ~50 QPS on the dedicated pool. Also require quality regression check against the customer's prompt set.

Luca (Runtime): Runtime notes: we'll need hot-prefix caching + KV eviction TTL + int8 variant support. Rough ETA: 3w dev + 1w integration testing. Owner: Luca. Blockers: model quant diffs and KV consistency under autoscale.

Sam (Infra): Infra can reserve 4x A100-equivalent GPUs in us-west-2. Need a capacity request by Mon 2025-10-30 to meet procurement. Suggest prewarm policy + autoscale with burst slots. Cost note: burst adds ~$3k/mo.

Jordan (Security): Security needs an HSM/KMS flow diagram and dataflow doc for review. Add me to the Confluence page and the threat model. Estimate 5 business days for review once doc is complete.

Aisha (Customer Success): Customer timeline: they want pilot in ~6 weeks if we can commit to the perf and isolation. They also need SOC2-compatible log exports and tenant isolation. I'll collect their test prompts and acceptance criteria.

Eve (Product): Proposed owners & deadlines: Runtime: @Luca -> 2025-11-15, Infra: @Sam -> 2025-11-03 (capacity request done by 10/30), Security design review: @Jordan -> 2025-11-07, PM acceptance/tests: @Eve -> 2025-11-20.

Priyanka (Eng): Main risks: quantized model causing quality regressions, perf regressions during autoscale. Suggest canary + automatic fallback to hosted smaller model for safety.

Luca (Runtime): Agree on canary plan. Canary rollout proposal: 10% traffic -> 30% -> 100% over 3 days with automated rollback on error budget. Example routing snippet for rollout config:

```
routing:
  - variant: runtime-int8
    weight: 90
  - variant: hosted-small
    weight: 10
canary:
  initial: 10
  step: 20
  max: 100
  rollback_on: [latency_p95>200ms, error_rate>1%]
```

Sam (Infra): We'll add prewarm + burst hooks to autoscaler and expose an API for the runtime to request prewarm slots. Also creating cost estimate card.

Priyanka (Eng): Also need a canonical prompt set and scoring metrics for quality checks. @Aisha can you own gathering customer prompts and expected scoring thresholds?

Aisha (Customer Success): Yes — will share a test set and scoring rubric by EOD tomorrow.

Eve (Product): Action items: owners update the Confluence checklist, attach perf runbooks, and link PRs to the launch board. Can each owner drop their task IDs here once created?

deploy-bot: created ticket INFR-4212 (infra capacity), RUNTIME-889 (runtime cache + canary), SEC-342 (security HSM review)

Jordan (Security): +1. I’ll start the review as soon as the doc is attached.

Luca (Runtime): Will open RUNTIME-889 PRs for int8 presubmit tests and KV cache feature flags today.

Sam (Infra): I’ll attach the capacity request and cost estimates to INFR-4212 by EOD.

Priyanka (Eng): One more ask — can we include a short post-launch observability plan (token-level latency, per-route error, sample outputs) so PMs can sign off?

Eve (Product): Yes — add that to the acceptance criteria.

Aisha (Customer Success): Sharing the prompt set and SLA expectations in the shared doc.

Eve (Product): Thanks all. If no objections, we’ll treat these owners/deadlines as committed and re-evaluate in Tuesday's roadmap review. :thumbsup:
